title: Valve has open-sourced Lepton, its tool to bring Android games to Steam.
excerpt: “Lepton is intended to help game developers bring their VR Android games to the Steam Frame,” Valve writes. “Lepton is not designed for general Android use, instead opting to keep the bare minimum functionality required to launch into games.” Developers have already used it to port Meta Quest games to the Steam Frame. But could it do more? [Link: frame-public / lepton | https://gitlab.steamos.cloud/frame-public/lepton | GitLab]
content_html:
Posted Sep 17, 2026 at 10:51 PM UTC

S

Valve has open-sourced Lepton, its tool to bring Android games to Steam.

“Lepton is intended to help game developers bring their VR Android games to the Steam Frame,” Valve writes. “Lepton is not designed for general Android use, instead opting to keep the bare minimum functionality required to launch into games.”
